description: §5.2.3 — a CALL-LED inline block on a button inside an `<each>` row, reading the row item (`@.name`), runs BOTH statements in source order: `track` records `@count` BEFORE the assignment, so `last` is `a:5` and `count` ends 0. Pre-S437 impl#1 kept only the first statement in every `<each>` row handler (`count` stayed 5). This is the braced fix E-MULTI-STATEMENT-HANDLER now steers each-row users to, so it must run every statement.
rationale: §5.2.3: "On each dispatch of the event, the statements of an inline block SHALL run in source order, each one exactly once … No statement of the block SHALL be dropped, whatever its kind or position — in particular, a statement's effect SHALL NOT depend on whether an earlier statement is a call or an assignment, or on whether the handler sits at top level, inside an engine state-child (§51.0.I), or inside an `<each>` row (§17.7)." One click on the first row: track("a") sees count 5 → last "a:5"; then count → 0.
